style: Surprising claim, then explain it step by step
lines: Your banana is slightly radioactive. Really.
Bananas contain a lot of potassium, a mineral your body needs.
A tiny part of that potassium is naturally radioactive.
So every banana gives off a very small amount of radiation.
How small? You would need to eat millions at once for it to harm you.
Your stomach would give up long before the radiation did.
So enjoy your banana. It is completely safe.
Send this to the friend who eats three a day.

style: Fact that sounds impossible, then the simple reason
hook:
A DAY LONGER
THAN A YEAR
lines: On Venus, a single day lasts longer than a whole year.
Venus spins very slowly. One full spin takes 243 Earth days.
But it only takes 225 Earth days to travel once around the Sun.
So Venus finishes a whole year before it finishes one spin.
It also spins the opposite way to Earth.
That means on Venus, the Sun rises in the west.
Follow for more planets that break the rules.

style: Comparison of two dates that nobody expects
lines: Sharks are older than trees.
The first sharks appeared about 450 million years ago.
The first trees appeared about 385 million years ago.
So sharks were swimming in the oceans long before any forest existed.
Since then, they have survived five mass extinctions.
That includes the one that wiped out the dinosaurs.
Follow for more facts about Earth's oldest survivors.

style: Weird animal fact, then why it is useful
lines: This animal makes poop shaped like little cubes.
It is the wombat, a small furry animal from Australia.
Its gut squeezes the poop into blocks as it moves through.
Wombats leave their poop on rocks and logs to mark their territory.
Round poop would roll away, but cubes stay where they are put.
So the strange shape actually helps them.
Comment if you knew this before today.

style: History fact that sounds wrong but is true
lines: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
The Great Pyramid was built around 2560 BC.
Cleopatra was born around 69 BC, about 2,500 years later.
The Moon landing happened in 1969, about 2,000 years after her.
So to Cleopatra, the pyramids were already ancient history.
Follow for more history that sounds wrong but is true.

style: Animal beats you at something, then how
hook:
IT HOLDS ITS BREATH
FOR 40 MINUTES
lines: A sloth can hold its breath much longer than you can.
By slowing down its heart, a sloth can hold its breath for up to 40 minutes.
Most people can only manage about one minute.
Sloths are also surprisingly good swimmers.
They move faster in water than they do in trees.
So the slowest animal on land is secretly great in water.
Save this for your next quiz night.
